body.title: Rewrite the steering and guide text
body.summary: Rewrite the approval and guide prose in steering-block.md so the controller calls insrc_present with the documents it asks the user to review before it asks for approval, and also gives the document's path in its message; the catalog row stays as t2 left it, and the steering-template needs no change beyond pointing at the block. Add a plain note that steering-only enforcement is accepted for now and should be revisited (a daemon-side reminder in tool responses, or detection of a missing call) if it proves unreliable. Update the steering-text pins in the tests.
acceptanceChecks: The steering block and guide tell the controller to call insrc_present before asking for approval and to give the path in its message
The steering text carries the revisit note for steering-only enforcement

tests.name: the steering block, the steering template and the guide tell the controller to call insrc_present before it asks for approval
